adversarial_audit.objection: Near-parallel disjoint child ranges create tiny relative probabilities.
adversarial_audit.resolution: After canonical parent whitening, linearly independent ranges are exact endpoint channels; their Euclidean angle does not create a fractional eigenvalue.

adversarial_audit.objection: Large recurring intersections necessarily kill the sampler.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Intersection size only counts weighted channels. If their child frames are equal or have computable balanced ratios, they may be the easiest part of the recursion.

adversarial_audit.objection: The W4 half ratios prove all orientation splits are balanced.
adversarial_audit.resolution: W4 has four leaves and sparse active sectors. Growing-depth nested frames can carry unequal incidence multiplicities.

adversarial_audit.objection: The rank theorem supplies a circuit for endpoint routing.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It is an algebraic localization theorem. A coherent basis-free implementation of the canonical routing projectors is open.

claim_gate.reason: The unresolved hierarchy is now localized to shared child ranges. Their all-n structure, balance, and coherent resolver remain unproved.

falsifiers_triggered: Do not use Euclidean near-parallelism of disjoint child ranges as a recursive-conditioning obstruction.
Do not treat recurring common ranges only as spikes to reject; they are precisely the weighted channels the sampler must route.
Do not promote finite half balance without an all-n incidence-weight theorem and coherent overlap resolver.

proof_obligations.resolution: Rank counting for C and I-C proves the identity exactly; generic and complete W4 controls validate conventions.
When child ranges intersect trivially, every relative eigenvalue is exactly zero or one, regardless of angle.
All W4 fractional relative effects are exactly one half, including controls with noncommuting child frames.
Existing recurring-irrep incidence certifies some common directions but does not exhaust nested child intersections.
No theorem prevents a shared range from carrying an exponentially unbalanced nonzero ratio between two children.
No polynomial transform labels all overlap cores and applies their matrix-valued conditional rotation coherently.

summary: Proved that strictly weighted relative-frame channels are counted exactly by child-range intersection dimension. Complete W4 controls are balanced at one half. The next theorem must classify and resolve nested overlap cores at typical large n.

theorem_contract.fractional_localization: The number of eigenvalues c in (0,1) is rank(A)+rank(B)-rank(S)=dim(range(A) intersection range(B)).
theorem_contract.new_asymptotic_target: Classify nested orientation-frame intersections, bound their relative weights away from nonexact endpoints, and implement their coherent resolver.
theorem_contract.proportional_common_core: On a reducing common core with A=aH and B=bH, the relative effect is the scalar a/(a+b).
theorem_contract.relative_effect: C=S^-1/2 A S^-1/2 on supp(S), S=A+B.
theorem_contract.sharp_routing: All dimensions outside the child-range intersection become exact c=0 or c=1 routing channels after parent whitening.
